tool_uses.command:
node -e '
const fs=require("fs");
fs.appendFileSync("CHANGES.md", `
## Round 1

Changed \`src/parse-ranges.mjs\`, \`tests/parse-ranges.test.mjs\` and \`README.md\`
to follow the REVIEW.md held-out findings (all 18 came from choices the task
left open):

- Order: pages come back in the order typed, not sorted (\`"5,1-3"\` is
  \`[5, 1, 2, 3]\`).
- Repeats: a page typed twice, or covered by two parts, comes back twice.
- Backward: a range written last-first runs backward (\`"5-3"\` is \`[5, 4, 3]\`)
  instead of throwing.
- Open end: \`"-3"\` means from page 1 and \`"8-"\` means to the last page. A lone
  \`"-"\`, \`"12-"\`, \`"-12"\`, \`"0-"\` and \`"-0"\` still throw \`RangeError\`.
- Empty: empty or all-space text means every page. Empty parts (\`"1,,2"\`,
  \`"1,"\`, \`",1"\`) still throw \`RangeError\`.

Tests that asserted the old choices were replaced with ones for the new
behaviour; the refusals REVIEW.md says must still hold (\`"1,,2"\`, \`"1,2,"\`,
\`",1"\`, \`"-"\`, \`"12-"\`, \`"-12"\`, \`"12-8"\`, \`"00"\`, \`"1 2"\`, \`"1 0"\`) are covered.
Checklist items 1-6 are unaffected. \`npm test\`: 21 pass, 0 fail.
`);'
